job.name: hist_host_a
job.meaning: мужчина ~35, тёмная короткая борода, тёмно-зелёный свитер, фон — полки старой библиотеки/архива с тёплыми лампами
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a Russian man about 35, short dark beard, thoughtful kind eyes, a dark green wool sweater over a collared shirt. Background: tall wooden shelves of an old library archive with leather-bound books and warm brass reading lamps, softly out of focus, warm cosy light. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens. Expression: calm, intrigued storyteller about to share a secret, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame shot on a modern camera, true-to-life colours, natural unretouched skin with pores, NOT a studio glamour portrait, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
